output.summary: The backlog growth is mostly self-generated. First-contact issues rose only 4% (8,770 to 9,120), and Payroll first-contact volume is about 380 a month. Agent-created split tickets rose from 240 to 3,710 a month, customer duplicates from 410 to 2,770, and the 14-day reopen rate from 6% to 23%. Quick-win cherry-picking began three days after the quota and reached 41% of picks. The exempt Billing-Compliance pod stayed flat. Capacity was roughly unchanged (6,020 to 5,960 scheduled hours), and the reopen metric is not a configuration artifact. Resignations are confounded by a rival employer paying 15% more and a deferred pay review. Engineering bugs rose from 40 to 71, so their effect on aged tickets is unestablished. Suspend the per-agent quota, move to team quality measures, and classify the aged tickets. Do not raise the quota or hire yet.
